name: v41_bfl_surface_total_accel_lowrisk
hypothesis: Low-crowding BFL composite score plus its acceleration may capture style improvement without raw accounting, analyst sales, option breakeven, or close/open reversal.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_bfl_total, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_bfl_surface_accel, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_bfl_quality, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (unsystematic_risk_last_60_days - unsystematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)
notes: Pure BFL score probe with low-risk stabilizer; watch coverage and sub-universe.

name: v41_bfl_value_growth_momentum_balance
hypothesis: A balanced BFL value/growth/momentum blend may be less correlated than raw EPS yield, operating quality, or analyst revision derivative.
expression: 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_bfl_value, 126), subindustry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_bfl_growth, 126), subindustry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_bfl_momentum, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Avoids analyst_revision_rank_derivative because v30 showed that branch becomes crowded when stabilized.

name: v41_model_accel_static_value_no_revision
hypothesis: High-coverage model score acceleration and static-score derivative may work without analyst-revision derivative or option-flow stabilizers.
notes: Controlled alternative to v29/v30: no analyst_revision_rank_derivative, no close/open, no option.

name: v41_social_fast_positive_attention_calm
hypothesis: Fast-d1 positive social sentiment with elevated attention but stable sentiment dispersion may be more useful than regular social attention fields.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 45), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_volume_fast_d1, 45), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_std_dev(scl12_sentiment_fast_d1, 20), 60), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_60_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Different from v28 regular social fields; uses fast_d1 matrices and calmness.

name: v41_social_fast_negative_buzz_relief
hypothesis: Low negative sentiment and improving relative social buzz may capture sentiment relief without RavenPack earnings or price reversal anchors.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_value_fast_d1, 45), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 45), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(scl12_sentiment_fast_d1, 45), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (unsystematic_risk_last_60_days - unsystematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)
notes: Tests social relief sign; no close/open or earnings sentiment.

name: v41_non_earnings_ravenpack_sentiment_basket
hypothesis: Non-earnings RavenPack sentiment may carry orthogonal event information compared with the existing earnings-news ACTIVE cluster.
expression: 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_corporate_action_sentiment, 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_equity_sentiment_score, 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_editorial_commentary_sentiment, 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_60_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)
notes: Avoids mean_earnings_evaluation_sentiment and rp_nip_earnings to reduce correlation with RRpmOAWj/O0pNbJ17.

name: v41_customer_spillover_slow_low_comp
hypothesis: Slow customer-return catch-up with customer authority and low competitive crowding may preserve relationship information while avoiding pure high-turnover customer-return failure.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_mean(rel_ret_cust, 5) - ts_mean(returns, 5), 60), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_num_comp, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Relationship return is only a smoothed component because pure customer return failed in v5.

name: v41_bfl_social_growth_momentum
hypothesis: BFL growth/momentum confirmed by fast-d1 social sentiment may form a different path from accounting quality, sales surprise, and option breakeven.
expression: 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_bfl_growth, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_bfl_momentum, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 45), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_60_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Crosses two underused families at moderate weights; strict corr gate if it unexpectedly passes.
